answer: Receipts are issued in canyon, burned on slash in relic, and listed in marble. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 10 epochs. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 3 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
